options.orbit: Threshold, then a central void. You pass between two objects and a screen just inside the door, then circle one hero object standing alone in a large empty void ringed by six small objects. Product stations sit at the four outer corners, outside the loop. The pay desk closes the loop at the back. Size: default 20 x 16 m.
options.field: One open low field. A floor strip leads from the door to a single large hero object; four sculptural stations hold the product in a loose ring around it, and the route wanders between them to the pay at the back right. Nothing but the hero is tall. Size: default 16 x 12 m.
options.chamber: A room inside the room. A walled chamber with two side openings stands in the middle; three low monoliths inside it carry the product; two blocks break through the chamber walls. The route enters the chamber, circles the monoliths and leaves. There is no single hero: the chamber is the event. Size: default 18 x 12 m.
options.ritual: A small ritual room. Shelf walls wrap the left, right and back; one object at the centre is where you pause first; a counter sits at the back. The route circles the centre, then follows the shelves. Size: default 12 x 10 m.

reply.title: Salt Desert Silence
reply.subtitle: An ethereal fragrance sanctuary in the heart of Busan
reply.line: You traverse a cracked earth path through a pristine salt landscape to discover hidden scents within monumental white formations.
reply.synopsis: You enter a vast, mineral-white clearing that captures the profound stillness of an ancient salt desert. As you walk along the central path of exposed strata clay, the stark void forces you to focus on the subtle shifting of light across the monochromatic terrain. You eventually reach the central salt dune monolith, where the surrounding fragrance clusters reveal themselves only as you draw near. This spatial rhythm transforms the act of shopping into a meditative exploration of scent and solitude.
reply.quote: In the absence of clutter, the scent becomes the only truth.

why.meaning: This linear path channels your movement from the city bustle into the quiet stillness of the desert floor.
The towering central monolith creates a sense of awe while keeping your sightlines clear across the vast, empty space.
These low-profile salt clusters ensure you must pause and lean in to experience the fragrance, deepening your personal connection to the product.
By tucking the lime plaster counter at the end of the route, the design ensures the commerce remains secondary to your sensory experience.
